assertions.assertion: JIT-Defects4J extends the manually line-labelled LLTC4J bug-fixing-commit corpus.
assertions.consequence: Prospective extension requires equivalent authoritative fixing-line evidence.

assertions.assertion: A positive is a bug-inducing commit attributed by git blame from manually agreed bug-fixing lines.
assertions.consequence: A bug-fixing commit alone cannot be labeled positive.
assertions.upstream_reference: Ni et al. 2022, Section 4, pp. 676 and 680

assertions.assertion: Historical label zero means a remaining commit not attributed as bug-inducing, not exhaustively verified clean.
assertions.consequence: Historical zeros are closed-world nominal negatives and cannot justify prospective zero assignment.
assertions.upstream_reference: Ni et al. 2022, Section 4: remaining commits treated as clean

assertions.assertion: The original issue identities and fixing-commit-to-bug mappings are available in this repository.
assertions.consequence: Prospective positive provenance cannot be reproduced from present evidence.
assertions.supporting_artifact: No matching local artifact after repository-wide search

assertions.assertion: A fixed verification-latency/observation window defines a supported negative.
assertions.consequence: No prospective nominal zero can become NEGATIVE_SUPPORTED.
assertions.supporting_artifact: No window in frozen configs, manifests, audits, or upstream Section 4

assertions.assertion: The package label field faithfully implements the publication procedure for every row.
assertions.consequence: Historical use is traceable at package level, but row-level issue provenance is absent.
assertions.supporting_artifact: Pinned data.zip hash and aggregate counts match publication Table 2

bug_fix_evidence_source: LLTC4J participant consensus on lines contributing to bug fixing
direct_or_szz: SZZ-family blame attribution constrained by manually validated repair-line evidence
mapping_rules: agreed repair line -> git blame antecedent; remaining commits -> nominal zero
negative_semantics: closed-world remainder not attributed as bug-inducing; nominal, not verified defect-free
original_repository_identity: per-project GitHub repository mapping pinned in canonical manifest
positive_semantics: LLTC4J agreed bug-fixing line -> git blame -> candidate bug-inducing commit -> positive commit
repository_transformations: replace package time with Git committer timestamp
preserve upstream binary target without recreating it
temporal_assumptions: original publication timeframe; repository canonicalization later uses Git committer time
